project.name: agent-eval-contract
project.identity: A public provider-neutral Python contract layer for portable agent evaluation records, JSON Schemas and external-result normalization.
project.audience: Harness, CI, notebook and downstream-tool authors who already run evaluations and need a stable exchange record.
project.core_loop: Supply an existing evaluation record or harness result, validate or normalize it into typed records, and export schemas or fixtures for downstream consumers.
project.north_star: Independent tools can exchange inspectable evaluation records without adopting a shared evaluation runner.
not_this: Running evaluations or calling model providers
Agent orchestration, benchmark datasets, history storage or hosted dashboards
Treating Quality Runner remediation as the product purpose
Claiming external evaluation correctness or publication from local fixtures

mvp.definition: A documented portable record, validation, normalization, schema and fixture contract for existing evaluation tools.

complete_product.definition: Compatible downstream consumers exchange records through the documented public surfaces; operational consumer evidence remains separate from local fixture checks.

pillars.name: Consumers can validate portable records and export schemas from the same model contract.
